name: The Voice
description: Contestants compete in a singing competition that focuses on the quality of their voice.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (1)
videos.overview: The highly anticipated, global phenomenon is finally here. Featuring superstar coaches Keith Urban, Seal, Delta Goodrem and Joel Madden, this is a music competition like no other.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (2)
videos.overview: Chris Sebastien, brother of Guy, takes the chance to prove he has what it takes to turn the coaches chairs, and a 17-year-old blind girl from Adelaide wants to the opportunity to be judged on her voice alone.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (3)
videos.overview: The blind auditions continue as the coaches fight it out for the artists who can take their teams to the top. After a slow start, Delta takes on the boys and starts to build her team with some crowd favourites.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (4)
videos.overview: The fourth night of blind auditions has Keith, Seal, Delta and Joel all battling over the best talent. From far north Queensland to Victoria and South Australia, the artists include an ex boy band singer.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (5)
videos.overview: As the coaches' teams of 12 start to fill, great singers are finding it harder to get the coaches' chairs to turn as the blind auditions continue.

videos.title: The Blind Auditions (6)
videos.overview: The blind auditions finish up as Keith, Seal, Delta and Joel round out their final teams.

videos.title: Let The Battles Begin (1)
videos.overview: In three phases of competition, contestants battle to progress to the next phase and ultimately secure a recording contract. Featuring the coaches' performance and hosted by Darren McMullen.

videos.title: The Battles (2)
videos.overview: In three phases of competition, contestants battle to progress to the next phase and ultimately secure a recording contract. Featuring the coaches' performance and hosted by Darren McMullen.

videos.title: The Battles (3)
videos.overview: In three phases of competition, contestants battle to progress to the next phase and ultimately secure a recording contract. Featuring the coaches' performance and hosted by Darren McMullen.

videos.title: Live Show: Semifinal (1)
videos.overview: The semifinal begins as coaches Delta, Joel, Keith, and Seal continue to find the best voice in Australia. Watch the remaining eight artists perform their very best and compete for a spot in the grand final.

videos.title: Live Final
videos.overview: The winner is announced. The voting lines are closed and the four coaches with the last remaining artist on their team perform a duet together before the votes are tallied and the winner announced.

videos.title: Battles 3
videos.overview: In the first live show of the series, the viewers at home get their first chance to vote on who remains in the competition and who goes home.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 1
videos.overview: The arrival of international chart topper Jessie J to The Voice, takes season four to a whole new level. It's clear from the get go that Jessie J is on fire, pitching hard for the artists.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 2
videos.overview: Team Madden are the only coach team without an artist going into day two. Newcomer Jessie J starts the night on fire, securing the first two artists.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 3
videos.overview: Heading into day 3 of the Blind Auditions Team Madden is trailing behind with just one artist in their line-up.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 4
videos.overview: Jessie J has become button shy as she waits for a great artist to blow her away. Meanwhile, Ricky's rampage hits the studio with him securing top artists for his team.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 5
videos.overview: It's the half way mark of the blind auditions and the pressure is mounting for both the coaches and the artists. The coaches are competing hard and while the Madden brothers are feeling united, the sisterhood of Delta and Jessie J is beginning to show cracks.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 6
videos.overview: British pop superstar Jessie J and Benji Madden are set to shake things up on the new season of The Voice, joining Delta Goodrem, Ricky Martin and Joel Madden as Coaches when The Voice returns for 2015.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 7
videos.overview: Mounting tension between Delta and Jessie J climaxes during a contestant's feedback with Delta taking a time out. A number of contestants fail to make it through, and Jessie J gives one fan an experience she'll never forget.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 8
videos.overview: British pop superstar Jessie J and Benji Madden are set to shake things up on The Voice, joining Delta Goodrem, Ricky Martin and Joel Madden as they fight to find the best voice in Australia.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 9
videos.overview: It's the closing chapter of the Blind Auditions and Jessie is on the hunt for two more artists, while the Maddens, Delta and Ricky have just one more spot to fill. The stakes are high as our coaches hold out for that perfect voice to round of their teams.

videos.title: Battle Round No. 1
videos.overview: British pop superstar Jessie J and Benji Madden are set to shake things up on The Voice, joining Delta Goodrem, Ricky Martin and Joel Madden as they fight to find the best voice in Australia.

videos.title: Battle Round No. 2
videos.overview: The second night of battles is a heated one as team member go head to head in the battle ring. Our coaches will have to make the tough decision of who wins, who loses and who they will steal from an opposing team.

videos.title: Battle Round No. 3
videos.overview: British pop superstar Jessie J and Benji Madden are set to shake things up on The Voice, joining Delta Goodrem, Ricky Martin and Joel Madden as they fight to find the best voice in Australia.

videos.title: Super Battle
videos.overview: British pop superstar Jessie J and Benji Madden are set to shake things up on The Voice, joining Delta Goodrem, Ricky Martin and Joel Madden as they fight to find the best voice in Australia.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: Ellie Drennan, Joe Moore, Nathan Hawes and Liam Maihi are the four finalists but before the votes are tallied and the winner is announced, the top 16 will perform and each remaining artist will sing a duet with their coach.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 1
videos.overview: Irish superstar Ronan Keating joins fellow coaches Jessie J, Delta Goodrem, the Madden Brothers and host Sonia Kruger in the fifth season of The Voice Australia, where the voices are out of this world.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 2
videos.overview: Irish superstar Ronan Keating joins fellow coaches Jessie J, Delta Goodrem, the Madden Brothers and host Sonia Kruger in the fifth season of The Voice Australia, where the voices are out of this world.

videos.title: Blind Auditions No. 3
videos.overview: Irish superstar Ronan Keating joins fellow coaches Jessie J, Delta Goodrem, the Madden Brothers and host Sonia Kruger in the fifth season of The Voice Australia, where the voices are out of this world.

videos.title: Battle Rounds No. 3
videos.overview: Irish superstar Ronan Keating joins fellow coaches Jessie J, Delta Goodrem, the Madden Brothers and host Sonia Kruger in the fifth season of The Voice Australia, where the voices are out of this world.

videos.title: Knockouts1
videos.overview: The Voice switches into the brand new Knockout phase of the series. Tonight teenage wonder Lucy Sugerman goes up against Brooke Schubert and powerhouse Liz Conde in a breathtaking Sia contest. Plus crowd favourite Judah Kelly returns.

videos.title: Knockouts 2
videos.overview: The Knockouts continue for a place in the next Battle round. In one of the most emotional moments of the series Queenslander teenager Brittania Clifford-Pugh faces up against 17-year-old Hoseah Partsch and the enigmatic James Banks.

videos.title: Knockouts 3
videos.overview: The Knockout rounds continue. Blind girl Lara Nakhale steps up against 4 chair turn Annalise Walker and stuntman Russel Francis. Plus country powerhouse Lyn Bowtell takes on a Beatles classic in her knockout.

videos.title: Battle Round 1
videos.overview: The Top 24 compete for a place in the Live finals. Sudden death, no steals. Tonight Lucy vs Camryn as the two youngest Artists compete plus Sarah vs Lynn

videos.title: Battle Round 2
videos.overview: The Top 24 compete for a place in the Live finals. Sudden death, no steals. Tonight opera singer Nathan vs Hoseah plus Judah tackles a Miley Cyrus song against Kelsie.

videos.title: Live Finals 1
videos.overview: The Voice goes Live as the top 12 compete in the Final stage of the competition. One artist will go home after a sudden-death sing-off.

videos.title: Live Finals 2
videos.overview: The 11 remaining artists compete for the title of The Voice of Australia and one more will be sent home after the live public vote. Special guest artist: The Veronicas

videos.title: Live Finals 3
videos.overview: The top 10 face a double elimination as the finale looms closer. Special guests are Jennifer Hudson and Hailee Steinfeld.

videos.title: Semi Finals
videos.overview: The semifinal show that will decide which four artists go through to the grand final. Special guests: Jessica Mauboy and 2016 Voice winner Alfie Arcuri.

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The top four battle it out for the title of The Voice Australia. Featuring special guests Katy Perry, Niall Horan and Noah Cyrus.

videos.title: Blind Auditions 3
videos.overview: The Blind Auditions continue with the coaches fighting over one of the most extraordinary artists in history of the program.

videos.title: Blind Auditions 4
videos.overview: The blinds continue with an incredible performance by an international All Star, and the youngest artist in program history takes the stage.

videos.title: Blind Auditions 5

videos.overview: The battle rounds continues with one of the most controversial match-ups in the history of the program, that causes a deep division within the Coaches.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (1)
videos.overview: It's the first night of the Blind auditions. New coaches Adam Lambert, LeAnn Rimes and Kate Miller-Heidke come out swinging. Will a school teacher and a FIFO worker convince them to turn a chair?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (2)
videos.overview: It's the second night of the Blind auditions, where seven new artists debut. They bring unique talents to the stage, aiming to capture the superstar coaches' attention and advance in the competition.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (3)
videos.overview: It's the third night of the Blind auditions and artists from all over Australia are hoping to turn chairs. Will a youth worker and a TikTok influencer have what it takes?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (4)
videos.overview: Tonight, The Voice puts the viewer into the Coaches' chairs to experience the full effect of a Blind Audition. Then, a veteran country music guitarist steps to the front of the stage to take his shot.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (5)
videos.overview: The fifth night of the Blind Auditions sees hopeful artists giving their all to turn chairs. An artist braves a Queen classic, and a country artist fights for a spot on LeAnn's team.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (6)
videos.overview: We're officially halfway through the Blind auditions and 7 new hopefuls take to The Voice stage, hoping they have what it takes to land a spot on one of the superstar coaches' teams.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (7)
videos.overview: Tonight's Blind Auditions showcase 7 more incredible artists. Natalie, a seasoned singer, is back from last year to hopefully turn a chair. And 16 year old Annie has plans to rock the stage!

videos.title: Blind Auditions (8)
videos.overview: With just a few spots left on each team, turning a chair is more challenging than ever. A group of passionate artists, including a young flutist and a unique beatboxer seek to impress the coaches.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (9)
videos.overview: It’s the second last night of The Voice Blind auditions and it’s harder than ever to get a chair to turn.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (10)
videos.overview: It’s the final night of the Blind auditions, as Kate and LeAnn go head-to-head to win the final artists for their teams.

videos.title: The Battles (1)
videos.overview: It's the first night of the Battle Rounds, as 16 artists go head-to-head in a do or die sing-a-palooza to secure their spot in the competition.

videos.title: The Battles (2)
videos.overview: It's night two of The Voice Battles and another 16 artists will go head-to-head to secure their spot in the Knockouts. Which artists will make it through, and who will see their Voice dream end?

videos.title: The Battles (3)
videos.overview: It's the third and final night of The Voice Battles, and the remaining artists go head-to-head to take the remaining spots in the knockouts. With one save left from Adam, who will be given a lifeline?

videos.title: The Knockouts (1)
videos.overview: They survived The Blinds and Battles, now the remaining artists from Team Kate & Team Adam have to get through The Knockouts. In the biggest cut of the season, the teams will be cut from 7 to just 2.

videos.title: The Knockouts (2)
videos.overview: It’s the second night of The Voice Knockouts. Tonight’s performances will determine who goes through to the Showdowns, where two artists from each team will earn their place in the Semi Finals.

videos.title: Semi-Final
videos.overview: In the Semi Final of The Voice Australia, only eight artists remain. By the end of the night, our superstar coaches will have to pick just one, to go through to the Grand Finale!

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: In the Grand Finale of The Voice, only four artists remain, each guided by superstar coaches. Each finalist delivers a show-stopping solo and a duet with their coach, showcasing their musical prowess.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (1)
videos.overview: A Voice revolution begins! Coaches Ronan Keating, Kate Miller-Heidke, Richard Marx & Melanie C kick off Blind Auditions, leaving no stone unturned in the search for The Voice 2025.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (2)
videos.overview: The Blind Auditions are heating up! Ronan is the only coach without any artists on his team yet... can he change that tonight? Or will the other coaches stand in his way?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (3)
videos.overview: Six artists sing for a spot on The Voice. From lifeguards to jewellers, each brings a unique story, and the coaches will do anything to get them on their team.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (4)
videos.overview: As we approach the halfway mark of the Blinds, these artists will show they aren't afraid to take risks to chase their dreams and secure a spot on one of our superstar coaches' teams.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (5)
videos.overview: A fresh batch of undiscovered artists steps into the spotlight for their Blind Auditions. Will they be ready for the pressure and expectation that comes with performing on The Voice stage?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (6)
videos.overview: It's over halfway through the Blind Auditions and the competition between our superstar coaches has hit an all new level. To secure these incredible artists, they'll pull out all the stops.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (7)
videos.overview: As Blind Auditions near the end, emotions rise. Will Ellaphon, Euan, Olivia, or Brother Angus impress the coaches and earn a chair turn with their powerful, unique performances?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (8)
videos.overview: With few spots left, Bella, Tiffney, and Meg give it their all. Will their bold, unique performances be enough to convince a coach to hit their button?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (9)
videos.overview: It's the final night of the Blind auditions! Melanie C and Richard have already filled their teams, and pressure is at an all-time high to win one of the final spots on Team Kate and Team Ronan.

videos.title: The Battles (1)
videos.overview: The Battles begin! Fourteen artists will step into the ring, paired off to deliver duets of the same song. But there can only be one winner per battle, forcing the coaches to make tough decisions.

videos.title: The Battles (2)
videos.overview: The Battles continue! 14 more artists enter the battle. Mel C and Ronan still have their Saves, giving a lifeline to a signer. Who will be able to rise to the challenge when the pressure builds?

videos.title: The Battles (3)
videos.overview: The Voice Battles conclude tonight! Expect mind-blowing performances, tough coach decisions, and maybe even a rule-break!

videos.title: The Knockouts (1)
videos.overview: They survived The Blinds and The Battles, now Team Melanie C & Team Richard face The Knockouts! Six become two. Who has the star power for the Semi-Finals?

videos.title: The Knockouts (2)
videos.overview: They survived The Blinds and The Battles, now Team Kate & Team Ronan face The Knockouts! Six becomes two. Who has the star power for the Semi-Finals?

videos.title: Semi-Finals (1)
videos.overview: It's The Voice Semi-Finals night one! Who from Team Richard and Team Melanie C will make it through?

videos.title: Semi-Finals (2)
videos.overview: Semi-Finals night two! Who from Team Ronan and Team Kate will make it through?

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: It's The Voice Australia Grand Finale! Four artists remain. Who will win?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (1)
videos.overview: The Voice is back, but the game has changed! Coaches Richard Marx, Melanie C, Ronan Keating and Kate Miller-Heidke have no idea a fifth coach is secretly building their own team.

videos.title: Blind Auditions (2)
videos.overview: The Blind Auditions are heating up! With no artists on Team Kate, is our reigning Queen feeling the heat? Will the other superstar coaches get one step closer to taking her crown?

videos.title: Blind Auditions (3)
videos.overview: Tonight’s chair-turning performances will reignite old rivalries. With all this talent on display, how far will our coaches go to convince these artists to join their teams?
